summary: A professional-grade development toolkit for the Factorio ecosystem that streamlines mod creation, automation scripting, and asset management with cross-platform compatibility and developer-first workflows.
key_features: Modular architecture with decoupled core, utilities, and configuration layers
Automated build, linting, testing, and .zip packaging pipelines
AI context filtering with .aiignore for optimized AI-assisted workflows
Hot-reloading and standardized development scripts for rapid iteration
achievements: Resolved cross-platform environment fragmentation by implementing automated LF normalization; architected a decoupled, modular codebase for scalable extension; engineered automated build and packaging pipelines that compile, optimize, and validate assets into production-ready .zip mods; optimized AI-assisted development workflows via context filtering; and implemented hot-reloading with asset optimization to streamline the developer feedback loop.
